verdict.rationale: TaxJar's API exposes a categories endpoint and accepts a `product_tax_code` on each line item, with code 20010 given as an example, so per-line taxability by product type is supported. However, the client library states product-level rules cover only "a subset of product categories", and TaxJar is positioned for US-only sellers, which limits the "every jurisdiction" part of the story. missing for 10: evidence naming specific SaaS, digital goods, services and physical-goods category coverage, coverage outside the US, documentation of how category rules vary by jurisdiction, and independent hands-on corroboration.
